title: Tech Note: Data encryption and decryption between 4D and PHP
author: Nicolas Brachfogel, Senior Developer, 4D SAS
featured_technology: BLOB TO DOCUMENT / DOCUMENT TO BLOB

historical_commentary.text: 4D's ENCRYPT BLOB/DECRYPT BLOB and GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR commands are still present in modern 4D; the interoperability caveats (PKCS#1 vs SubjectPublicKeyInfo, 4D's proprietary header bytes) remain accurate for any classic-4D-encryption-to-external-system integration.
